name: Slate Notes
description: Slate's notes in a small window of their own, installed and updated separately from Slate.
notes: The Workspace has its own icon in the sidebar.
The sidebar is only as wide as your longest Open link, so the tabs run no further than they need, and Notes no longer shows a count
Dark mode is a step lighter, the same greys as the iPhone apps
Today: your figures as a strip with the budget as a bar under them, the lists over two columns with room for every task, and one plus for the quick actions
On a Mac, Slate now reads your vault, so the Learning routine shows on Today and syncs to your phone
